code='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    above = grid[:divider]
    below = grid[divider + 1:]
    a2 = sum(r.count(2) for r in above); a4 = sum(r.count(4) for r in above)
    b2 = sum(r.count(2) for r in below); b4 = sum(r.count(4) for r in below)
    # The output tracks the marker that is more prominent in the top section
    # when the lower sections are balanced, otherwise the longer lower marker.
    if b2 == b4:
        color = 4 if a2 > a4 else 2
    else:
        color = 4 if b4 > b2 else 2
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
'''
